SmartLab Universal Diffractometer 
 Facility:
Materials Synthesis and CharacterizationCategory:
X-Ray and Light ScatteringThin Film Metrology Full Catalog 
Rigaku SmartLab is a universal diffractometer capable of characterizing thin films, bulk powders, and surfaces. Supported techniques include small and ultra-small angle scattering, in-plane diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, powder diffraction, high resolution diffraction, micro-diffraction, surface mapping and reciprocal space mapping. The Rigaku SmartLab is equipped with cross beam optics for point or parallel beam geometries and low noise area detector. The Anton-Paar DHS 1100 stage attachment enables in-situ high temperature studies at up to 1100 °C.
